subject: people at every wedding
caption: There is always one aunt filming the whole thing vertically.

beats.text: Every wedding has these four people. One of them is you.
Started at the vows. Hasn't stopped. It's the speeches now.
Has one playlist. It is 2011. Nobody has told him.
Filming vertically. The whole ceremony. From the front row.
Arrived. Brought a plus one. Brought a chair.
You are one of them. You cried. Admit it.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
